findings.location: plan-v2.md frontmatter line 11 (total_tasks: 34) and Purpose section line 73 ("34 executable tasks across 7 phases")
findings.description: Frontmatter declares total_tasks: 34 and Purpose body says "34 executable tasks". Actual task count in body is 31 (T0.1–T0.5 + T1.1–T1.7 + T2.1–T2.3 + T3.1–T3.5 + T4.1–T4.4 + T5.1–T5.5 + T6.1–T6.2 = 5+7+3+5+4+5+2 = 31).
findings.rationale: Cross-Artifact Audit consumes total_tasks as a structural anchor. Frontmatter↔body inconsistency could mask an unintended task drop OR a stale count from an earlier iteration.
findings.suggestion: Update frontmatter total_tasks: 34 → 31 AND Purpose body "34 executable tasks" → "31 executable tasks". Localized 2-line edit; no DAG or AC-mapping impact. Per ADR-0005, frontmatter in-place edits are permitted while status: draft.

findings.location: plan-v2.md line 268 — T1.7 Satisfies AC field
findings.description: T1.7's Satisfies AC field reads "Substrate for AC-FR-3 (full phase-quality stage exercisable); enables T6.2 end-to-end smoke test." Per plan-authoring discipline anti-pattern guidance, every task either satisfies ≥1 AC OR is explicitly tagged N/A — setup (and setup tasks live in Phase 0). T1.7 is a Phase 1 phase-internal smoke test that neither cleanly maps to an AC nor sits in Phase 0. Plan's coverage check (line 796) groups T1.7 with Phase 0 setup tasks under an N/A — setup exception, but the per-task line itself doesn't make this explicit.
findings.rationale: review-cross-artifact-auditor at Gate 6 checks AC↔task mapping; the current formulation could be misread as a phantom AC. The exception is reasonable but should be explicit at the per-task level for downstream auditor consumption.
findings.suggestion: Replace the Satisfies AC line with: `N/A — phase-internal smoke test (substrate for AC-FR-3; enables T6.2 L3 integration verification)`. Pure text clarification; no semantic change.

findings.description: Plan template guidance (plan-template.md line 173) suggests typical Plans run 200–500 lines; >1000 lines indicates feature too large for single pipeline run. Plan v2 at 853 lines is within bounds but on the upper end.
findings.rationale: Length is a smell, not a defect. The feature scope (5 new agents + 3 skills + 7 scripts + 5 templates + 4 ADRs + 1 spec update + ~20+ planning-side wildcard) justifies this; the per-task detail is appropriate given the cycle-3 corrections that must be precisely transcribed.
findings.suggestion: No action required. Surface as observation only. If subsequent reviewers find specific sections that could be tightened, individual edits can be applied; do not preemptively trim the document.
